A within-category paired user bootstrap resamples the 200 validation users with replacement, preserving each user’s hit indicators across compared configurations; each replicate averages the four category-level HR@10 differences equally. Pairing preserves covariance between predictions on the same users ([SciPy documentation](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html)). Applied here, this estimates user-resampling variability of the observed difference while treating fitted models, selected checkpoints, training data, seed and each user’s sampled candidates as fixed. It does not separately measure variability from retraining, new negative-candidate draws, or new categories. Population interpretation requires representative, approximately independent users within each category.

Because these same validation users selected checkpoints and configurations, freezing the winners before bootstrapping does not account for adaptive selection or remove winner’s optimism. The resulting interval is descriptive uncertainty for the selected comparison, without a guarantee of nominal post-selection coverage or unbiased held-out improvement. Model-selection research documents this optimism when optimizing a noisy finite-sample criterion ([Cawley and Talbot, 2010](https://www.jmlr.org/beta/papers/v11/cawley10a.html)). Appropriate wording: “Paired bootstrap intervals describe validation-user resampling variability for fixed selected models and fixed candidate sets; they exclude training randomness and checkpoint/configuration selection uncertainty.”

HR@10 against 99 sampled negatives measures the pinned sampled-candidate task. Sampled ranking metrics can reverse full-catalog model orderings, even in expectation, so bootstrap precision cannot establish full-catalog superiority ([Krichene and Rendle, 2020](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)). Preserve the evaluator and report uncertainty with that scope; reserve claims about independently evaluated performance for the host’s held-out evaluation.
